decisions: Keep the 22.48B XRP exchange-labelled wallet total as custody context, not tradable float; it includes cold, wrapped, operational and affiliate balances.
Do not interpret the 133M seven-day same-wallet aggregate decline as confirmed customer withdrawals or net capital leaving exchanges.

Revise the Binance incident-reserve hypothesis downward: XRP Insights' Binance same-wallet set is +17.6M over 7d and +30.3M over 30d, while prior CryptoQuant reserve measurements use a different address universe and window.

Keep Binance's 100% XRP backing as a company claim pending full zk proof and same-time reserve-address/customer-liability reconciliation; 90% aggregate incident coverage is not an XRP-specific purchase quantity.
Treat ETF flows as issuer-holdings-derived creations/redemptions proxies, not gross spot execution or total actual capital; keep GXRP reporting gap explicit.
Keep RLUSD Coinbase distribution separate from native XRP purchases; Coinbase Global Exchange RLUSD collateral support was planned, not live, at the October 28 announcement.
Keep TradRadar OI, funding, liquidations and account ratios provider-specific; negative Bybit/OKX funding and account/notional distinction prevent simplistic crowded-long classification.
Treat the November 1 1B XRP escrow as FinishAfter eligibility only; require validated EscrowFinish, Destination, subsequent transfer and EscrowCreate evidence before classifying supply or selling.
Main Cross Analysis still writes a timestamp-only sentiment_shift file when sample counts are zero; PR #1429 proposes read-only artifact output and is CI/gate verified but unmerged.
No market feature is admitted and no directional forecast is issued.
required_verification: At 2026-11-01 00:00 UTC and after, query both escrow objects at pinned validated ledgers; record EscrowFinish hashes, senders, amounts, Destination and ledger indexes.
Trace destination balance changes, subsequent transfers and new EscrowCreate objects.
Obtain official Binance XRP PoR address export and full zk proof; reconcile exact XRP customer liabilities and reserves at the same cutoff.
Crosswalk five incident source wallets against Binance PoR and provider-specific exchange-reserve address sets.
Reconcile XRP ETF issuer holdings and daily creations/redemptions; preserve missing funds as pending, not zero.
Obtain wallet-level transfer histories for Coinbase, Binance, Upbit and SBI-labelled wallets before interpreting exchange changes as customer flows.
Extend derivatives data to contract-level aligned history, notional long/short and order-book depth.
PR #1429 remains draft; merge requires approval.
